from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    """Stamp the rare colored motif at every translation whose motif cells are zero."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    # The motif is the rare non-background color; the uniform background is most common.
    color = min((v for v in counts if v != 0), key=lambda v: counts[v])
    points = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == color]
    min_r = min(r for r, c in points)
    min_c = min(c for r, c in points)
    shape = {(r - min_r, c - min_c) for r, c in points}
    max_r = max(r for r, c in shape)
    max_c = max(c for r, c in shape)
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for dr in range(h - max_r):
        for dc in range(w - max_c):
            if (dr, dc) == (min_r, min_c):
                continue
            if all(grid[dr + r][dc + c] == 0 for r, c in shape):
                for r, c in shape:
                    out[dr + r][dc + c] = color
    return out
PY
